content.text:
Continue Stage 6.3 only.

Scope:
- Products admin integration
- Categories admin integration
- Inventory admin integration

Do not modify:
- Orders
- Customers
- Analytics
- Payments
- Checkout
- Notifications
- Authentication

Use existing:
- Laravel Sanctum APIs
- ErrorBoundary
- Retry utilities
- Black/Gold luxury theme
- Arabic RTL support

Keep enterprise-grade quality suitable for a real perfume brand.

Stop after completion and provide a summary of all changes.
